description.text: Starter Sets Fire Flareon-GX, Water Vaporeon-GX and Lightning Jolteon-GX, three 60-card decks released together on 23 November 2018, built around the Eeveelutions of Pokémon Red and Green. Each holds three Pokémon-GX: two of its Eeveelution and an Eevee-GX, a Pokémon-GX that can still evolve and whose Ability heals all its damage as it does. Each also has four Cynthia and two Guzma, Supporters in high demand at the time. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a rule book and a player's guide came with each. This set holds the cards of all three.
